description: Synthesized company overview: what they do, sector, stage, website summary, recent activity. Combines Twitter profile, website scrape, and AI classification. Use `include` to get the FULL picture of one company in ONE call instead of four - include="resources,founders,funding" bundles what frontrun_company_resources, frontrun_company_founders and frontrun_company_funding return. Each section draws on usage like its dedicated tool. Founders use nothing when none are found and funding uses nothing when nothing resolves, same as the dedicated tools. Note: include=founders uses the fast cached lookup, so a brand-new stealth company comes back resolution_status "resolving" - call frontrun_company_founders for the blocking live resolve.

include.description: Comma-separated sections to bundle in: "resources", "founders", "funding". Example: "resources,founders,funding". Founders are free when none are found, funding is free when none resolves.

max_credits.description: Optional spend ceiling for this one call. Fails closed: if the call could use more, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

name: frontrun_company
